queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name IN ('eM Client (Updater)', 'eM Client') AND publisher = 'eM Client s.r.o.';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name IN ('eM Client (Updater)', 'eM Client') AND publisher = 'eM Client s.r.o.' AND version_compare(version, '11.0.1054') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'mailclient.exe');
